reason: A learning-focused AI system that organizes learner evidence, tracks knowledge gaps and reviews, and supports agent-guided practice through Git-backed memory and a local panel.

summaries.zh: 面向学习场景的 AI 插件，用 Git 管理学习证据、知识 gaps、复习状态，并通过本地面板引导后续练习。
summaries.en: An AI learning plugin that manages evidence, knowledge gaps, and review state in Git while guiding next-step practice through a local panel.

capabilities: Maintains learner-owned learning state and evidence in a Git repository
Applies authorized learning records through reversible Git commits
Provides read-only learning status and routing observations
Displays an agent-maintained learning queue in a local panel
Supports scheduler integration for recurring learning checks
